Vorbis decoder (no encoder — see note below).

Ports symphonia-codec-vorbis (lib, codebook, floor, residue, dsp, window) plus the BitReaderRtl/VLC machinery it needs from symphonia-core/src/io/bit.rs. Least-significant-bit-first throughout. An encoder is deliberately out of scope (a quality Vorbis encoder is a psychoacoustics project of its own; Symphonia ships none either).
